objective: One default-OFF in-process engineering composition of accepted runtime03 and frozen client API03. No campaign, model research or Native qualification.

dependencies.conditional: Recorder/metrics independent Role4 acceptance and Mayor exact-source approval still required; none inferred from this task.

peer_read_budget.not_read_or_used: native_services_smoke.py, its readiness asyncio.run, unsealed work or new model research.

implementation_contract: Synchronous preparation uses prepare_capture and persists its exact raw-v2 preparation envelope before any future start is chosen.
An explicit future shared start is chosen after local preparation; runtime.start_at must match, with the actual local monotonic clock.
The caller supplies the existing NominalServices owner interface: original deadline, reserve and check(). No service ownership is created.
Default-OFF explicit episode opt-in and existing runtime experimental flag/permit remain required; source/config mismatches refuse before HTTP.
Use only capture_replay and write_capture for client collection/persistence; never copy SSE, row mapping or capture codec.
Run controller and recorder concurrently. Inspect exceptions plus returned failure/refusal/pending/deadline envelopes, not just task completion.
Cancel and join both workers on failure/cancellation, preserve partial capture, runtime journal and every observed result/error, and propagate caller cancellation after persistence.
Use original absolute deadline and reserve, never restart them. Record cooperative cleanup overrun truthfully.
Do not compute natural metrics or full wall for engineering. Admission effect, ordered owner ledger and post-cleanup full wall remain missing/null and Mayor-owned.

validation.runner: Only test_nominal_episode.py using unittest; no peer/old/full suites.
focused_cases: Shared future start, real NominalRuntime/planner path plus real client API, original five-offer schedule and full captured outcomes.
Default-OFF, ready-false and unsupported/past-start/deadline/binding no-start refusals persist exact raw capture.
Returned controller refusal and recorder refused/failed envelopes cancel the other worker and retain both results.
Caller cancellation during the burst joins controller/recorder/request tasks and persists partial raw capture and runtime journal.
validation.fixtures: HTTPX MockTransport and literal owner/tokenizer interfaces only. Tokenizer fingerprint hook is explicitly CPU-fixture evidence, not actual tokenizer/model verification. No live authority artifact.
validation.environment: unset PYTHONPATH, threads=1, no bytecode/autoload/cache, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, nice -n19, -B
validation.failure_policy: Keep exact frozen source and all failures; one attempt, no blind retry or further source generation.

prohibitions: No peers/runtime/services/planner/metrics/forecaster/SDK/product edits, agents, Git, installs, Markdown, real-service HTTP, SSH, GPU, threads/processes/service launch by the adapter, signals, Train Fixed/Eval, model changes, adaptive workloads or qualification/winner claims.
handoff: Exact API, source/input pins and copies, actual diff, one CPU result with all failures, raw evidence and owned cleanup, limitations, SHA256SUMS; idle.
